issues.card_says: block worth about ₹1,327 Cr, roughly 15% of SML's ₹8,732 Cr market cap

issues.card_says: offer_price ₹1,554.60 (MEMORY) applied to the 85,33,053 SPA shares, check VERIFIED

issues.card_says: Revenue Q4FY26 >= 0.0 (target 'positive')

cards.headline: ACIL Q4FY25 revenue ₹1,216 Cr, up 4.5% YoY; FY25 PAT fell 46% to ₹202 Cr

The ₹416.74 Cr matches construction + sub-contract + other expenses lumped together (5,934.33 + 33,717.95 + 2,021.61 lakh). The two periods are on different line definitions

issues.card_says: Q4 margin recovered on higher revenue and lower other expenses

issues.card_says: gross margin -3118 bps, fixed-cost absorption +3239 bps

issues.card_says: FY25 exceptional items only ₹0.37 Cr; Q4FY25 exceptional items ₹0.11 Cr
issues.pdf_says: Exceptional items were 0.00 in Q4FY25 and FY25. ₹0.11 Cr and ₹0.37 Cr are the share of profit of the joint venture (11.15 and 37.21 lakh)
74,639.49 is the standalone figure for Mar-2024; consolidated is 74,558.57 (+5.3% to 78,494.54)

issues.card_says: Order book FY25 ₹7,794.37 Cr

issues.card_says: Met: EBITDA margin Q4FY25 target >= 9 (set 2025-02-11)
